lyrics.text: The city skips a beat, I feel it in my bones,
Streetlights flicker gold, then split to undertones.
Every broken glow keeps calling me because
There’s rhythm in the ruin, and echoes in my blood.
The pavement starts to shift, the skyline bends and sways,
Neon on the rails, fire running through the haze.
I step into the slip, let the whole world rearrange,
I was born for the motion, I don’t run from the strange.
Static in the air, it shivers and it gleams,
Is this a warning sign or the edge of all my dreams?
I hear the bass below, I let it pull me higher,
One more breath, one more step, my heart’s on fire.
When the world breaks down, I move with the sound,
Feet hit the floor and the fear can’t hold me down.
Three echoes, one soul, I dive through the dark,
Turn the noise to a rhythm, turn the rhythm to a spark.
Oh-oh, I flow, I don’t fight it, I become it.
Oh-oh, I know, every broken beat is coming.
If the night wants war, then let it take aim—
I dance through the danger and I light up the frame.
Static in the air, it shivers and it gleams,
I wear the danger well, I make a home in dreams.
The deeper that I go, the brighter burns the fire,
One more breath, one more step, my heart’s on fire.
When the world breaks down, I move with the sound,
Feet hit the floor and the fear can’t hold me down.
Three echoes, one soul, I dive through the dark,
Turn the noise to a rhythm, turn the rhythm to a spark.
Oh-oh, I flow, I don’t fight it, I become it.
Oh-oh, I know, every broken beat is coming.
If the night wants war, then let it take aim—
I dance through the danger and I light up the frame.
The map tears open, but I don’t lose my way,
Left, then right, let the pulse lead the play.
A sign on the wall, a mark in the glow,
I trace it with my hand and the whole world says go.
I don’t need the dawn to tell me who I am,
I’ve got light in my chest and blood in the jam.
If the city falls out of line tonight,
Then I’ll pull it back in with my feet and fight.
Up, up—heart rate, left, right—don’t stop,
Beat in my ribs and it won’t let drop.
Life gets sharp, but I’m still whole,
I make art from the chaos, fire from the soul.
When the world breaks down, I move with the sound,
Feet hit the floor and the fear can’t hold me down.
Three echoes, one soul, I dive through the dark,
Turn the noise to a rhythm, turn the rhythm to a spark.
Oh-oh, I flow, I don’t fight it, I become it.
Oh-oh, I know, every broken beat is coming.
If the night wants war, then let it take aim—
I dance through the danger and I light up the frame.
Whoa-oh—
I don’t fade when the lights cut out,
I burn brighter.
Whoa-oh—
Even lost in the noise, I know
My heart’s on fire.
There’s rhythm in the ruin,
And echoes in my blood

lyrics_rap_words:
They said don’t chase ghosts through a glitched-out sky,
But I’ve still got a name that I can’t leave behind.
Every zone that tears, every door that sings,
Might be one more clue in the heart of the strings.

Friends at my side, or alone in the storm,
Either way I keep moving, let the chaos take form.
Pretty little grin, sharp teeth in the blue—
If the boss starts laughing, then I’m laughing too.
